pr_title: GameEngine: fix managed WSL Ubuntu detection
pr_body:
## Summary

Fixes a false-negative ADR0155 WSL userland check observed on a correctly provisioned Ubuntu 22.04.5 GameEngine-LocalAI distribution.

The managed runtime now reads /etc/os-release as data and parses ID/VERSION_ID in Rust before running the CUDA bootstrap, instead of sourcing the file and comparing shell variables inside the WSL command string. This removes host/shell expansion sensitivity while keeping the exact Ubuntu 22.04 requirement.

Adds regression coverage for the Ubuntu 22.04.5 os-release form and ensures the CUDA bootstrap no longer embeds os-release variable logic.

Windows-native setup is unchanged. Visual Validation is not required because no UI layout/rendering changes are involved.
